name: Feet-Elevated Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on your back with your heels on the bench, knees bent to about right angles and arms beside you.
Brace your core and drive through your heels to lift your hips upward until your torso and thighs form a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes firmly at the top while keeping your ribs down.
Lower your hips slowly back to the floor with control before starting the next repetition.
tips: Stop lifting when your hips form a line with your knees and shoulders.
Press through your heels rather than letting your feet slide forward on the bench.
